purpose: Determine whether the remaining J1A discrepancy is double-precision cancellation in the symmetric finite-difference oracle while leaving the frozen C1R face representation and all precommitted perturbations unchanged.

frozen_candidate.representation: C1R N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility table in u=log10(-h)
frozen_candidate.table_values: the exact generated float32 values, promoted without smoothing or refitting

finite_difference_precommit.cell_boundary_cap: 0.05 times distance to nearest table-cell boundary
finite_difference_precommit.explicit_rule: Exactly the original J1A perturbations are reused. No perturbation-size tuning is permitted.

high_precision_oracle.flux_law: independent flux-only direct-head evaluation of the same bilinear log-mobility interpolation and driving-gradient law
high_precision_oracle.table_promotion: Decimal.from_float(float(float32_table_value)) so the qualified table values are preserved exactly as binary floats before high-precision arithmetic
high_precision_oracle.perturbed_heads: the exact binary64 h plus/minus step values used by the qualification probe, promoted with Decimal.from_float

diagnostics: record high-precision FD and direct-head binary64 FD side by side
record worst normalized and absolute derivative differences
record derivative magnitude controlling any residual failure

exit_rule.pass: Classify original J1A/R1 failures as finite-difference oracle roundoff amplification, qualify the closed-form real C1R face derivative on strict table-cell interiors, and permit J1B same-factorization whole-column response tangent work.
exit_rule.fail: Keep J1B closed. The remaining discrepancy cannot be attributed solely to binary64 finite-difference cancellation; investigate derivative algebra or interpolation semantics without table retuning.

scope_guards: No saturation, heterogeneous, groundwater or MODFLOW claim.
